opening.argument: The presentation centers participation on paid entry and recruitment: it requires a $99 membership, offers pools costing $500, $1,000, or $2,000, and connects compensation to inviting fee-paying participants. It promotes founder-level participation as the most profitable option, describes returns continuing for 1,000 days, and presents recurring percentage payments alongside substantial daily and monthly earnings. The income framing is especially ambitious: it says, “by the third year I think your income will be already about 1 million a year,” presenting that figure as an expectation while acknowledging that building the MLM business can take years. This combination of escalating payments, tiered recruiting, and long-term earnings projections establishes a recruitment-based commission scheme rather than a straightforward Bitcoin opportunity.
